chapter: Bands, leaders and radio of the thirties and forties
title: Ethel Waters standing to sing, with Bunny Berigan
summary: Morehouse recalls Ethel Waters standing to sing on the Stormy Weather date, which was unusual for singers.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: No, okay. According to.... one of the vocalists was Ethel Waters and how did she perform? Tell me again.
And you say she did what while she was singing? What did she do? You say she stood up?
And the musicians - is this unusual for the singer to stand up?
Well, yes it is because half of the singers don't stand up.
Oh really, okay. Bunny Berigan was on with you on that recording date.
